candidates.statement: Canada's Food and Drugs Act and Regulations set out specific reporting requirements and timelines for mandatory reports. These include requiring regulated parties to report serious or unexpected adverse reaction. Reports must be made within 15 calendar days of receiving or becoming aware of the information about the adverse reaction.
